manifest.name: Ruby on Rails
manifest.server: Puma 8.1 behind Thruster 0.1, as in the Dockerfile rails new generates
manifest.workers: Puma cluster mode: WEB_CONCURRENCY = BENCH_WORKERS (2) workers x 3 threads (the generated RAILS_MAX_THREADS default)
manifest.database_layer: Active Record (pg 1.7), up to 8 connections per worker (16 in total)
manifest.logging: Rails at warn (no request lines); Thruster's request log off
manifest.notes: The rails new production setup; force_ssl stays commented out (no TLS) and db:prepare does not run at start-up.

build.versions:
ruby 4.0.9
rails 8.1.4.1
activerecord 8.1.4.1
actionpack 8.1.4.1
puma 8.1.0
pg 1.7.0
thruster 0.1.27

manifest.name: Axum
manifest.workers: Tokio multi-threaded runtime, one worker per available CPU (2)
manifest.database_layer: SQLx 0.9 (Axum has no ORM; its examples use SQLx)
manifest.notes: Baseline: every job measures it on the same runner as the framework under test.
